05/08/2009: Data Correction:                                            [1030] 
 
            - Precipitation data appears to have been faulty  
              prior to the repairs made on 05/06/2009.  Therefore, 
              all precipitation data has been marked as "missing" 
              during the following time period: 
  
                 01/01/09 [d=001] 00:05  -  05/06/09 [d=126] 15:00 
 
 
            - Soil Temp (4") data appears to have been faulty  
              prior to the repairs made on 05/06/2009.  The sensor 
              appears to have failed on 11/09/2008 at 20:00.   
              Therefore, all 4" Soil Temperature data has been  
              marked as "missing" during the following time period: 
 
                 11/09/08 [d=314] 20:00  -  05/06/09 [d=126] 15:00

              issues when the cell modem powers-on which is 
              leading to some faulty and missing data.

                     - MSTR 0:  profile of depth =  0 - 12" 
                     - MSTR 1:  profile of depth = 12 - 24"

            - Work was done approx: 1445 - 1530 (Day=164)

05/06/2008: Data Collection Enabled:

                 First data report:   May 06, 2008 - 00:05 (Day=127) 
 
 
05/05/2008: Station Maintenance:

              data collection PC/server on campus.    
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program:    MAWN_ABCS 
                                               A => CR10X 
                                               B => CS616  
                                               C => Broadband Cell Modem (IP) 
                                               S => Summer Schedule (30-minute update)
